messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT 2205003333 - auth-proxy unusual outgoing connections detected from auth-service in us-west-2. rate: 8k/min, distinct dest IPs: 720. Suspected credential sync or exfil attempt. Pager: @jamal (oncall).

maria (Sec): seeing this alert in SIEM too. correlation id shows repeated token-validate calls with empty user-agent. possible leaked token reuse. tagging @security-analyst.

jamal (SRE-oncall): I’m up. starting triage. pulling recent logs and token audit.

eli (prod-eng): adding context — we deployed authv2 two days ago, but rollout rate was low. any recent config changes to token TTLs?

shaun (SRE): not aware of TTL changes. I’ll check conf git and envs.

jamal (SRE-oncall): quick checks:
```
# fetch tokens with repeated failures
jq -r '.events[] | select(.status==401) | .token_id' /var/log/auth/*.json | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```
Found ~300 distinct token_ids being validated 20-200x each. many from same client_id.

maria (Sec): ok that smells like replay using compromised service tokens. we should: 1) rotate service tokens for affected client_id(s), 2) block outbound to suspicious IP ranges at proxy, 3) notify customers if scoped keys exposed.

ops-bot: Firewall rule proposal created: block 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/24 for auth-service egress (temp). ID: FR-2205-7.

jamal (SRE-oncall): applying egress block now to auth-service pod selectors. will monitor.

shaun (SRE): I pushed egress deny to canary, no errors so far. rolling to remaining replicas.

maria (Sec): security-analyst, can you run a KMS key rotation plan for the service-account keys tied to client_id alpha-42? we want scope-limited rotation first, then full if we see persistence. also pull HSM audit.

security-analyst: starting rotation runbook. steps: revoke current service tokens for alpha-42, create new keys in KMS with alias redwood/alpha-42/rot2205, update auth-service env via secrets-manager, rotate pods to pick up new secrets. ETA ~12-20m.

eli (prod-eng): note: we should use gradual rollout to avoid auth storms. set concurrency limit low and ramp. also enable fallback for dependent services to short-circuit retries.

jamal (SRE-oncall): implementing graceful rollout. will add rate-limiter patch to auth proxy to drop excess validation attempts from same token_id.

maria (Sec): customer impact check: I see ~3500 failed validations in the last 10m affecting 4 orgs. initial severity: medium-high. Outreach required if keys were private. prepping customer brief.

shaun (SRE): monitoring telemetry: request latency returned to baseline after egress block. abnormal outbound dropped by 89%.

ops-bot: Incident incident-2205-az started and routed to Security & SRE. Slack bridge created #incident-2205-az (private).

jamal (SRE-oncall): rotation started. creating short-lived tokens for alpha-42 (30m TTL) to validate downstream.

security-analyst: rotated KMS keys and revoked old tokens. updated secrets-manager. rolling pods.

eli (prod-eng): confirming deployments picked new secrets. no obvious 500s so far. some clients are retrying aggressively — throttling rules applied at CDN level.

maria (Sec): prepare customer notification draft: non-public tokens tied to client alpha-42 may have been reused. advise rotation and monitor. send to legal for review.

jamal (SRE-oncall): handing over active mitigation to shaun for monitoring and to maria for customer comms. I’m off-call in 10.

shaun (SRE): taking over monitoring. will watch for token replay resuming and higher latencies. open action items: 1) keep egress block for 2 hours, 2) verify KMS HSM audit for key export events, 3) produce short post-incident timeline.

maria (Sec): ack. legal looped in. create PSIRT ticket and include timeline.

ops-bot: Action items created: AI-2205-01 (keep egress block) assigned to shaun, AI-2205-02 (HSM audit) assigned to security-analyst, AI-2205-03 (customer comms) assigned to maria.

security-analyst: HSM audit shows no export operation. likely tokens were exfiltrated from a CI job earlier today — investigating job logs.

jamal (SRE-oncall): final note before I sign off: we should add token-use heuristics to alerting (sudden fan-out > 100 for token_id) and temporary rate caps. filing a follow-up ticket.

maria (Sec): agreed. thanks everyone. will post summary in #postmortems once we have timeline. :white_check_mark:

shaun (SRE): monitoring continues. will update thread if anything changes.

oncall-bot: NOTE: thread locked to incident responders only.
